people.bio: English civil servant who publicised the religion of Wicca from the 1950s.

people.name: Doreen Valiente
people.bio: English Wiccan priestess and poet, author of much of the Wiccan liturgy including the "Charge of the Goddess".

people.name: Dion Fortune
people.bio: British occultist (Violet Firth), founder of the Society (Fraternity) of the Inner Light and author of "The Mystical Qabalah".

people.name: Aleister Crowley
people.bio: English occultist, founder of Thelema, initiated in the Golden Dawn; owned Boleskine House.

people.name: Samuel Liddell MacGregor Mathers
people.bio: Co-founder of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn (1888) and translator of grimoires.

people.name: Emma Restall Orr
people.bio: English druid and writer who founded The Druid Network.

people.name: Philip Carr-Gomm
people.bio: Chosen Chief of OBOD from 1988 to 2020, pupil of Ross Nichols.

people.name: Kathy Jones
people.bio: Founder of the Glastonbury Goddess Temple and the Glastonbury Goddess Conference.

people.name: Cecil Williamson
people.bio: Founder of the Museum of Witchcraft, which settled in Boscastle in 1960.

people.name: Karl König
people.bio: Austrian paediatrician who founded the Camphill movement near Aberdeen in 1939-40.

people.name: Douglas Harding
people.bio: English philosopher whose "On Having No Head" launched the Headless Way.

people.name: Christmas Humphreys
people.bio: English barrister who founded the Buddhist Society in London in 1924.

people.name: John Crook
people.bio: British ethologist and Chan teacher, dharma heir of Sheng Yen, who founded the Western Chan Fellowship.
